concept_uz: Choʻl-u dashtda egizaklar ishoralar bilan oʻynashga ruxsat soʻraydi. Plyusda oʻrin almashsa farqi yoʻq, minusda — bor. Plyus burilib «×», minus qiyshayib «/» boʻladi; Nol ularni koʻpaytirish va boʻlish deb ataydi. Oʻyin qanday boʻlmasin, javob doim Minus Bir! Shunday qilib toʻrt amal dunyoga keladi.

style_line: Premium 3D animated feature film style, gentle split light — cool moonlight from the left, warm sunlight from the right — soft shadows, rich colours, vertical 9:16. No text, no captions, no letters or numerals written anywhere, no watermark.

refs.prompt: Vertical 9:16 full-body character portrait. A round king shaped like a thick, chunky upright ring with a small hole in the middle, so its wide front face is a disc. The ring is coloured like a yin-yang: the left half dark moon-silver with one small bright gold dot, the right half bright sun-gold with one small dark silver dot, the two halves curving into each other in a smooth S-shaped wave — made of polished metal, not a flat printed symbol. Big kind expressive eyes and a small mouth on the front of the ring, thin cartoon arms and legs, a small jewelled crown tilted to the left, holding a long plain wooden staff. He stands in the middle of a vast low-poly crystal plain, exactly where the cool left side meets the warm right side, front view, centred.

Vertical 9:16 full-body character portrait. A slim upright sun-gold character shaped like a tall narrow pillar with a small slanted flag-like tip at the top, big cheerful eyes, a wide smile, thin cartoon arms and legs, and a small round badge with a plus sign pinned on its chest. It stands on the vast low-poly crystal plain, front view, centred.

Change this character: exactly the same shape, size and face, but made of shining moon-silver instead of gold, eyebrows lowered in a grumpy frown, arms crossed, and a horizontal dark-blue sash wrapped across its middle instead of the plus badge. Same plain, same framing, full body, front view.

Vertical 9:16 wide landscape. A vast empty low-poly crystal plain made of smooth faceted triangular polygons: cool lavender-blue facets on the left, warm amber facets on the right, blending softly in the middle. A thin glowing straight path runs across the ground from left to right through the centre. The sky is split the same gentle way: soft twilight indigo with a few stars on the left, where a pale moon with a gentle old woman's face smiles; warm morning light on the right, where a big warm sun with a kind old grandfather's face — smiling eyes, bushy eyebrows and a beard of rays — smiles back. Not dark, just a gentle difference between the two sides. No characters.

Close-up of the sun from this picture: a big warm glowing sun with a kind old grandfather's face — smiling crinkled eyes, bushy golden eyebrows and a beard made of soft rays — filling the frame against the warm morning sky. Same style and colours. Vertical 9:16.

Close-up of the moon from this picture: a pale silver moon with a gentle old grandmother's face — soft kind eyes, a few smile lines, a tender smile — filling the frame against the twilight indigo sky with a few stars. Same style and colours. Vertical 9:16.

Put these three characters together on this crystal plain: the yin-yang ring-king exactly in the centre, the gold twin one step away on the RIGHT side of the picture (the warm sun side) and the silver twin with the dark-blue sash one step away on the LEFT side of the picture (the cool moon side). All three face the camera, full body, the twins not touching each other. Keep every character design exactly the same. Vertical 9:16.

Vertical 9:16 wide landscape. A rolling desert of smooth low-poly crystal dunes made of faceted triangular polygons: cool lavender-blue dunes on the left, warm amber and honey-gold dunes on the right, blending softly in the middle. A thin glowing straight path runs across the dunes from left to right, with small round glowing marker stones placed at exactly equal distances along it; the marker stone in the middle glows gold. Fine crystal sand drifts off the dune crests in the wind. The sky is split the same gentle way: soft twilight indigo with a few stars and a pale moon with a gentle old woman's face on the left, warm morning light and a big warm sun with a kind old grandfather's face and a beard of rays on the right. No characters.

Put these three characters into this crystal-dune landscape, walking toward the camera along the glowing path: the yin-yang ring-king exactly in the centre holding his staff, the gold twin with the plus badge one step away on the RIGHT side of the picture (the warm sun side) and the silver twin with the dark-blue sash one step away on the LEFT side of the picture (the cool moon side). Full body, a little crystal sand blowing around their feet. Keep every character design exactly the same. Vertical 9:16.

Vertical 9:16 wide landscape. A small cosy oasis in the middle of low-poly crystal dunes: a round turquoise pond that sparkles, tall palm trees with faceted emerald crystal leaves, and beside the pond a low wooden Uzbek tapchan bed covered with a red patterned carpet and cushions, under a striped canopy, with a blue-and-white teapot and two small piyola tea bowls on a low table. Cool lavender light from the left, warm golden light from the right. No characters.

Put this yin-yang ring-king on the carpeted tapchan of this oasis: he sits cross-legged among the cushions, his staff leaning against the canopy pole, holding a small piyola tea bowl in one hand, eyes half-closed and content. Keep the character design exactly the same. Medium-wide shot, vertical 9:16.

Same oasis, the king still sitting on the tapchan in the background. In the foreground, by the pond, the gold twin stands on the RIGHT side of the picture holding up in both hands a big glowing gold crystal plus sign about the size of its head, and the silver twin with the dark-blue sash stands on the LEFT side of the picture holding a glowing silver crystal bar of the same size horizontally. They grin at their new toys. The badge and the sash stay on their bodies. Keep every character design exactly the same. Full body, vertical 9:16.

Change only the two crystal toys, keep everything else exactly the same: the gold plus sign is now turned an eighth of a turn so it stands as an X-shaped cross (a multiplication sign), and the silver bar is now tilted so it stands slanted like a slash, its top leaning to the right. Both crystals glow a little brighter. The twins stare at them with wide surprised eyes. Vertical 9:16.

Same oasis, same moment, but the yin-yang ring-king has got up from the tapchan and now stands between the twins by the pond, holding his staff: the gold twin with the glowing X-shaped cross on the RIGHT side of the picture, the silver twin with the glowing slanted slash on the LEFT. Same three characters at the same oasis, but the king now raises his staff high, and above its tip four glowing crystal signs float in one straight row, from left to right: a gold plus sign, a silver horizontal bar, a gold X-shaped cross, a silver slanted slash. The twins look up at them in awe, the evening sky turning golden. Keep every character design exactly the same. Vertical 9:16.
